title: The Super Mario record
text: Super Mario Bros. came out in 1985. It is one of the most famous games in history. Millions of people played it as children. But for speedrunners, it became a race that never ends.

A normal player needs hours to finish the game. Speedrunners finish it in less than five minutes. How did they do it? They used warp pipes to skip worlds, and they discovered tiny tricks to save time.
For many years, players fought for every hundredth of a second. In 2018 a runner called Kosmic got a very fast time. Then other runners like Niftski and Kosmic broke the record again and again.
Did they play for fun? Yes, but they also trained a lot. Some runners played the first level thousands of times. They studied the game frame by frame to find the perfect route.
In 2023 Niftski finished the game in four minutes and fifty-four seconds. Experts say it is almost impossible to go faster. But did people believe that before? No, and the record fell again!

grammar.title: Grammar: questions in the past simple
grammar.rule: To ask questions in the past simple, use did + subject + verb (without -ed).
rows: Yes, they did. / No, they did not.
items: What did they ___ to skip worlds?
